Emitted cgi-io upload failures use response() which prints Status 200 with a JSON failure body, not failure(403). Those responses have http_status 200; outcome distinguishes invalid_request / upload_denied / missing_session / path_denied. A complete request without filedata can return without response(); no_response has no HTTP status and is not an ACL denial.
Filename is canonicalized before the file ACL check so a '../' suffix cannot match /etc/luci-uploads/* while linkat/open resolves outside that prefix.

shellquote and basename are not sanitizers. canonicalize_path is a textual path normalizer, not a taint sanitizer.
